description: Plain-English guide to the 8 stages of a VA disability claim, from Intent to File through the C&P exam, the rating decision, the three AMA review lanes, the Board of Veterans’ Appeals, and the 120-day deadline to appeal to the Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims. With no arguments, returns an overview of all stages with typical durations; with a stage number (1–8), returns that stage in depth: what to expect, typical timing, a key tip, and do/don’t guidance. Covers what happens after filing, what a C&P exam is, and what each stage involves. Educational only, not legal advice.

stage.description: Stage number 1-8 for a deep dive on one stage. Omit for an overview of all eight stages.
